top_fixes.rule: Asking for a plan, lower instalments or more time in general: describe nothing, `transfer_to_agent` queue `restructuring`, close transferred with code TRS.
top_fixes.why: In the hardship node a customer asking for a plan, lower instalments or more time is told 'you cannot offer that' instead of being transferred to restructuring, so these cases get the wrong close (not transferred/TRS) and miss the transfer_to_agent call.
top_fixes.fix: hardship node and hardship_notes node: in task_message, delete 'if they ask for one, say you cannot offer that' and write 'If the customer asks for a plan, lower instalments or more time: describe no options, move to the restructuring transfer.' Add a topic field with a 'new_plan' value (description 'wants a plan / lower instalments / more time') to the extraction_schema. Add the transition 'topic equals "new_plan" -> xfer_restructuring' ahead of the other routes, so the call goes through transfer_to_agent queue restructuring -> fin_transferred_restructuring (outcome transferred, reason TRS).

top_fixes.rule: Asking for a person: transfer straight away with no "can I help you first"; `transfer_to_agent` queue `general`, close transferred with code TRH.
top_fixes.why: A customer in the hardship or hardship_notes node who asks for a person cannot be transferred, because neither node has transfer_to_agent or a route to fin_transferred_human, so the transfer call and the transferred/TRH close are missing.
top_fixes.fix: hardship and hardship_notes nodes: add the tool transfer_to_agent with queue baked as 'general', the same way ask_phone/negotiate do. Add the transition 'transfer_to_agent_success_count greater_than 0 -> fin_transferred_human' (outcome transferred, reason TRH). Add this task_message line: 'If the customer asks for a person: call transfer_to_agent straight away, no "can I help you first".'

top_fixes.rule: Every `close_call` carries one outcome from the fixed list and exactly one code in `reason`; a close without a code is rejected.
top_fixes.why: close_outcome/close_code are first set in the setup code node, which runs only after the first customer turn, so a hang-up during the opening sends an empty reason that pre_process_code drops, and the close is rejected.
top_fixes.fix: Seed vars close_outcome='not_reached' and close_code='UNC' before the opening node is entered, either as initial workflow variables or in a code node placed before opening. In the close_call tool pre_process_code, stop popping an empty or unresolved reason: if reason is empty or still '{{close_code}}', set body['reason']='UNC' and body['outcome']='not_reached'.

top_fixes.rule: Thank the customer and say goodbye, then exactly one `close_call` as the last tool call of every call, always with an outcome and a code, including promise (PRM) and paid (AP) closes even though the API marks reason optional for those; nothing is accepted after it.
top_fixes.why: The end_wrong_number, end_deceased and end_unclear farewells say goodbye without thanking the customer, so they miss the required closing courtesy.
top_fixes.fix: Terminal spoken_message: end_wrong_number becomes 'I apologise for the inconvenience. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.' Add 'Thank you for your time.' before 'Goodbye' in end_deceased and end_unclear too, and keep the condolences sentence in end_deceased word for word.
